result.renderer: forward static geometry; legacy preview or GGX metallic/roughness with PNG/JPEG material maps; fixed directional light; no shadows

limitations: Normal maps/tangent frames, texture transforms, secondary UV sets, GPU compression and streaming are not implemented.
Texture references and samplers remain immutable import data; factor overrides are editable. Native procedural material authoring remains future work; example art is generated offline.
Renderer still has one fixed directional light and ambient approximation, serialized GPU waits and no shadows/IBL/GI.
Only this laptop NVIDIA/AMD Vulkan output and native Linux/Windows import paths qualified. No native Linux GPU, production workload, console or performance qualification.
Khronos Vulkan validation layers and physical human input remain unqualified.
